questions.question: Which of the following is a plant hormone?
options: Insulin
Thyroxin
Oestrogen
Cytokinin
questions.explanation: Cytokinin promotes cell division in plants. Insulin, thyroxin, and oestrogen are animal hormones.
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

questions.question: What is the difference between a reflex action and walking?
options: Reflex is voluntary; walking is involuntary
Reflex is automatic without thinking; walking is a voluntary action
Both are controlled only by the spinal cord
Walking is faster than a reflex action
questions.explanation: Reflex actions are sudden and automatic; walking involves conscious decision by the brain.
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

questions.question: What happens at the synapse between two neurons?
options: Electrical impulse jumps directly across the gap
Chemicals cross the gap and trigger impulse in the next neuron
The axon splits into two dendrites
The impulse is stored permanently in the gap
questions.explanation: At the synapse, electrical impulse triggers release of chemicals that diffuse across and start an impulse in the next neuron.
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

questions.question: Which part of the brain maintains posture and equilibrium of the body?
options: Cerebrum
Cerebellum
Medulla
Hypothalamus
questions.explanation: The cerebellum in the hind-brain controls posture, balance, and precision of voluntary actions.
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

questions.question: Give an example of a plant hormone that promotes growth.
options: Insulin
Auxin
Adrenaline
Thyroxin
questions.explanation: Auxin promotes cell elongation and is involved in phototropism. Insulin and adrenaline are animal hormones.
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

questions.question: How does our body respond when adrenaline is secreted into the blood?
options: Heart rate slows and digestion speeds up
Heart beats faster, breathing increases, blood diverted to muscles
Blood sugar drops immediately
All voluntary muscles relax completely
questions.explanation: Adrenaline prepares for fight-or-flight: faster heartbeat, increased breathing, blood to skeletal muscles.
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

questions.question: Why is the use of iodised salt advisable?
options: Iodine makes food taste better
Iodine is needed for thyroxin synthesis; deficiency causes goitre
Iodine kills bacteria in food
Iodine increases height in adults
questions.explanation: Thyroid gland needs iodine to make thyroxin; iodine deficiency leads to goitre (swollen neck).
questions.chapter_ref: NCERT Class 10 Ch 6 — Control and Coordination

Stimulus detected → message carried → response produced
Nervous = fast; endocrine = widespread and sustained.
